record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare DOUBLE_EDGE (catalog passive NONE). The strategy is shared; differences are star count and stats.
record.summary: Single-target PHYSICAL damage to the cast target (requested 55/110/220/440 by stars), then, unless the caster holds Protective Pads, PHYSICAL recoil on the caster itself (requested 20/40/60/80 by stars). Both go through handleSpecialDamage with the caster as attacker and the cast's crit flag, so both are multiplied by (1 + caster AP/100) and by the crit factor if the cast crit; both are reduced by the receiving unit's DEF (halved under armorReduction), ceil, minimum 1. The recoil is not a fixed amount: it scales with the caster's own AP and crit, is reduced by the caster's own DEF and shield, and is blocked if the caster has protect/skydiving/magicBounce active. The damage call's return value (takenDamage) is not used. The requested numbers are raw, not final HP loss. Only 1- and 2-star units declare this ability (HISUI_GROWLITHE 55/20, HISUI_ARCANINE 110/40).

targeting.who: the cast target passed to the strategy (damage); the caster itself (recoil)
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the base default true; target selection before the cast was not read.

effects.scaling: requested raw amount; AP: x (1 + caster AP/100) (apBoost defaults to true); DOUBLE_DAMAGE effect on the caster doubles it once and is consumed here; the STRANGE_STEAM_BOARD_EFFECT board effect x1.2; the cast's crit flag multiplies by 1 + (critPower - 1) x critReductionFactor (target's Rocky Helmet sets the factor to 0, each Black Augurite held by the target's player subtracts 0.1, floor 0), only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault is false, so needs ABILITY_CRIT); an enraged caster doubles it in handleDamage
effects.resolution: applied change, not the requested amount: blocked entirely (takenDamage 0) by protect / skydiving / magicBounce on the target (a magicBounce bounce only fires for SPECIAL, this hit is PHYSICAL). Otherwise handleDamage divides by (1 + 0.05 x DEF) (DEF halved rounded under armorReduction; swapped with SPE_DEF under WONDER_ROOM), then item/effect reductions, ceil, minimum 1; a target with reflect returns part of PHYSICAL damage to the caster unless the caster has Protective Pads (reflect branch read only in outline); shield and Cover Band redirect follow the shared takenDamage branches. The returned takenDamage is discarded by this strategy.

effects.scaling: requested raw amount; the same path as the hit: AP x (1 + caster AP/100) (apBoost true, attacker = caster), crit factor using the cast's crit flag (the caster's own Rocky Helmet / the Black Augurite of its own player reduce it), enraged x2. The DOUBLE_DAMAGE effect was already consumed by the first call, so it does not double the recoil.
effects.resolution: applied change: skipped entirely if the caster holds Protective Pads. Otherwise handleSpecialDamage on the caster: blocked if the caster has protect / skydiving / magicBounce; handleDamage divides by (1 + 0.05 x own DEF), ceil, min 1; the caster's own shield absorbs first; it can reduce the caster's HP (death handling of a self-kill was not traced). Cover Band on the caster could redirect a lethal self-hit (shared branch, not traced for this case). Reflect on the caster would act on this PHYSICAL self-hit but the reflect branch returns damage to the attacker, which is the caster itself (not traced further).

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 3-star (220/60) and 4-star (440/80, also the fallback) values are not reachable by the two units' bare star counts (1, 2). maxPP 100 and range 1 for both.

record.positionalConditions: None read beyond needing a target (the unit must be in range of it to cast, since requiresTarget is true).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state, no modes. Each cast repeats hit and recoil.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested (raw): hit 55/110 and recoil 20/40 (1/2 stars). Applied: each is x (1 + caster AP/100) [x crit factor] [x2 enraged] [x2 DOUBLE_DAMAGE for the hit only], then divided by (1 + 0.05 x DEF of the receiving unit), ceil, min 1; the recoil is therefore reduced by the caster's own DEF and shield and is absent with Protective Pads; the hit is blocked by protect / skydiving / magicBounce on the target, the recoil by the same on the caster. takenDamage reported by handleDamage (shield included) is not used by the strategy.
